factsheet.heading: Bermondsey through time: architecture and industries
paragraphs: A walking tour of Bermondsey, examining the changing face of Bermondsey through its buildings industries and community. Discover how the industrial revolution shaped the area and how that legacy continues to influence Bermondsey today. Participants will witness the area’s regeneration and transformation and discover a strong sense of belonging created by the people of Bermondsey who worked in demanding industries. They will also see the remarkable historical buildings that have survived and found new purpose. The tour celebrates the beauty resilience and diversity of Bermondsey's architecture and public spaces.

factsheet.heading: Golden Key Academy
paragraphs: The Golden Key Academy is a course training up insightful and engaging guides dedicated to explaining London and bringing its many stories to life. This tour is part of a wider collection of tours created by Golden Key Academy guides for the Open House Festival celebrating their conclusion of the eight month course.
Further information on the Golden Key Academy can be found here https://open-city.org.uk/golden-key-academy
If you would like to attend this tour, please ensure you have booked a ticket before turning up.
